Marta (People Ops): Rolling out an asynchronous calibration packet pilot for teams with heavy timezone spread. Goal: reduce live meetings while keeping alignment and auditability. Read the flow and decide whether your team should opt-in. :globe_with_meridians:
Ken (Manager): Quick Q 9 how is this different from the usual org micro-calibs?
Marta (People Ops): Good Q. Short answer: instead of everyone meeting live, managers assemble a short packet (10-min voice summary + filled scorecard + 2 evidence bullets + 2 peer excerpts). People Ops and a small panel review packets, call out mismatches, and only schedule brief syncs for disputed cases. Ideal for distributed teams.
Tara (Manager): Are packets allowed for promotion nominations?
Marta (People Ops): No for promotions. Promotion/level-change nominations still require a live micro-calib to ensure robust discussion. Async allowed for routine ratings and low-risk changes only. Promotions are escalated to the promo panel.
Ibrahim (Manager): What's inside the packet? Is there a template?
Marta (People Ops): Yes  use the template linked in the tracker. Minimal required payload: 
``` 
Async packet template:
- 10min voice note (MP3 link)
- Filled scorecard (PDF link / form)
- Evidence (2 bullets, 1-2 sentences each)
- Two peer quotes (inline)
- Conflict flags (Y/N) + notes
```
Priya (Recruiter): For contractors/conversion candidates, any extra steps?
Marta (People Ops): Conversions need finance approval attached. Mark the "conversion" flag on your packet and include the headcount note from Recruiting. Ops will hold packets with conversion flags for an extra 24h for finance review.
Owen (Eng): Embargo rules for async packets? Can other managers see them?
Marta (People Ops): Provisional packet visibility: other managers on the panel can see packets for alignment, but ICs cannot. DO NOT share packets outside the panel. Full embargo on publishing final ratings until manager 1:1s begin on 2026-04-12 09:00 UTC.
CalBot: Reminder: async packet upload window opens in 72h and closes 48h before cross-org review window. Upload link: https://rwd.co/async-packets :bell:
Tara (Manager): If I miss the upload window, what's the fallback?
Marta (People Ops): If missed >48h before cross-org, People Ops auto-assigns a floater reviewer and runs a short live triage. If you know you'll miss it, notify @people-ops at least 24h before the window closes and paste a minimal handoff: current draft feedback + 2 peer snippets + one-line open question in the backfill column.
Eve (Manager): How do we record dissent or appeals with async packets?
Marta (People Ops): After final publish, there's a 72h dissent window. Use the appeal form in the tracker, include the packet ID and 3-bullet rationale. People Ops will triage and may convene an adjudication panel (3 senior managers + one Ops). Appeals don't block payroll shuffles while under review.
Ibrahim (Manager): Retention and recordings policy? Some packets include voice notes.
Marta (People Ops): Packet retention: voice notes + packet artifacts stored for 90 days for audit then archived. Live recordings (if any) auto-delete after 45 days. Sensitive items must be org-internal only.
CalBot: Posted: async packet how-to live drop-in tomorrow 30m. Sign-up: https://rwd.co/async-dropin :calendar:
Marta (People Ops): We'll publish the 3-slide explainer + the packet template in #docs tonight. If your team wants to opt into the pilot, toggle the "async" checkbox in the sign-up tracker by EOD Friday. Ping @people-ops for help or urgent exceptions. Thanks! :pray:
